==========================
Group use with a trailing comma
==========================

<?php
use Foo\Bar\{ Baz, Qux as Q, };

---

(program
  (php_tag)
  (namespace_use_declaration
    (namespace_name
      (name)
      (name))
    (namespace_use_group
      (namespace_use_clause
        (name))
      (namespace_use_clause
        (name)
        (name)))))
